reason_for_revision: v3 missed its 5% reference-relative TV gate by 9.23e-6 in one of 80 cases. v4 adds a reference-free convex projection to at most 1.05 times the final coarse-cell TV; the failing v3 case was used only to verify this mechanism before freezing v4.

model.name: entropy-stable TVD-FV plus jump-gated, cell-TV-capped conservative DKAN subcells

benchmark.note: No listed amplitude was evaluated in v1-v3 or sensor development. The target sine family and viscosity 0.001 were absent from pretraining.

primary_metric.definition: fixed-MC normalized L2 divided by gated-DKAN normalized L2
primary_metric.aggregate: geometric mean over all 16 parameter cases per seed, followed by median over five seeds
primary_metric.success: median aggregate gain >= 1.20 and bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound > 1.00

secondary_gates.per_case_no_material_degradation: gated L2 <= 1.05 * fixed-MC L2 for every seed-case pair

entropy_scope: The Godunov finite-volume flux is entropy stable and determines time evolution. The subcell map is locally bounded, mean preserving, and TV capped and is not fed back into the solver.
claim_boundary: Passing supports the Burgers hybrid branch only; Euler and a final ten-seed float64 protocol remain required for the overall 20% claim.
